report_name: New NERC Rule for Low-Impact Systems Creates Audit & Compliance Risks

identities.name: North American Electric Reliability Corp. (NERC)
identities.description: The standards body that created the CIP-003-9 rule, which imposes new security controls for vendor remote access to low-impact Bulk Electric System (BES) cyber systems.

identities.name: Centrii
identities.description: The firm that analyzed and highlighted the compliance and audit risks associated with the NERC CIP-003-9 standard.

identities.name: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC)
identities.description: The U.S. government agency that provides NERC with its enforcement authority, capable of imposing penalties for non-compliance with standards like CIP-003-9.

identities.name: Owners and operators of low-impact Bulk Electric System (BES) cyber systems
identities.description: The broad category of NERC-registered entities affected by the CIP-003-9 standard. This includes renewable energy facilities, energy storage sites, and smaller generation and transmission facilities.
